title: Workbench tooling fixes found while bringing the stack up on Linux
notes: (1) backend/.npmrc sets symlink=false (a Windows workaround); on Linux pnpm 10.28/10.33 then fails in the @prisma/engines postinstall (cannot find @prisma/debug) — wb install passes --config.symlink=true without editing the repo. (2) seed:content-templates imports @ticktrade/shared, so wb db:seed builds the shared package first. (3) tsx/playwright are resolved from `npm root -g` instead of a hard-coded home. (4) probe/smoke launch the pre-installed Chromium (/opt/pw-browsers) and stub Google Fonts, which the sandbox browser cannot reach.
